# Authenticated Learning UAT — 13 October 2026

## Scope and safety

- Local `jlas`, `http://localhost:8080`; no DROP, TRUNCATE, destructive seed, or reset of the owner's account.
- Dedicated LOCAL Selenium learners are created per run; random passwords exist only in each runner process environment. These are test identities, not released content.
- Existing dirty checkout preserved. No commit, push or Jira transition.

## Runner recovery

Chrome 155.0.8059.39 and its matching cached ChromeDriver now run real DOM assertions.
The prior `-DargLine=...` override was ineffective: the project's Surefire configuration defines its own Mockito agent argLine.
The Windows JDK Unix-domain loopback workaround works when inherited by both Maven and its forked JVM via `JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS`:

```powershell
$env:JAVA_HOME = 'C:\Program Files\Java\jdk-21'
$env:JLAS_HEADLESS = 'true'
$env:JLAS_CHROMEDRIVER_PATH = 'C:\Users\LAPTOP LENOVO\.cache\selenium\chromedriver\win64\155.0.8059.39\chromedriver.exe'
# This path must NOT exist: failed Unix socket bind lets JDK use TCP loopback.
if (Test-Path 'D:/FALL26_FPT/SEP490/target/selenium-no-unix-socket') { throw 'Choose a nonexistent socket path' }
$env:JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS = '-Djdk.net.unixdomain.tmpdir=D:/FALL26_FPT/SEP490/target/selenium-no-unix-socket'
& 'D:\JAVA\apache-maven-3.9.11\bin\mvn.cmd' -o '-Dmaven.resources.skip=true' '-Dtest=FullSpecSmokeE2ETest' '-De2e.excludedGroups=' test
```

This is process-local; no global JDK, firewall or security setting changed. CDP-version warnings remain, but ordinary WebDriver assertions execute. The app already running on port 8080 was retained; the duplicate app started by the agent was stopped.

## Findings and verification

1. **LOGIN-VALIDATION — fixed and browser-retested.** Empty credentials and malformed email silently returned because `loginForm` has `novalidate`, while `validateForm()` only returned a boolean. Existing Selenium AUTH-02/AUTH-03 failed before the fix. `login.js` now reuses the existing field-error and focus helpers; no authentication or password policy changed. Rerun: all four `FullSpecSmokeE2ETest` cases passed (desktop, phone, empty fields, malformed email), zero skips.
2. **E2E-FLASHCARD-STALE — runner updated.** The old page object looked for removed `remember` mode and self-grade buttons. The first full journey reached a real Vocabulary activity and failed there. The page object now flips each card and advances through the existing browse controls, then opens the real quiz. No API bypass or fake pass added.
3. **E2E-NUMBERED-PROMPT — runner corrected.** A visible quiz number before a reverse Vocabulary prompt made the Selenium helper choose a meaning instead of the Japanese word. A focused test failed before the correction, then all three helper tests passed.
4. **Authenticated prefix passed:** local login → N5/N4 survey (60 min/day) → all Smart Test sections → result → generated V2 path → four Vocabulary activities (first package completed at 100%) → two Kanji activities. This is not all score/level combinations and not full-path acceptance.
5. **Roadmap read race — fixed and browser-retested:** on 8080 the first read after the Vocabulary package showed `INTERNAL_ERROR`; an immediate second read was correct. On a dedicated 8081 app, Selenium passed 10 activities (4 Vocabulary, 5 Kanji, 1 Grammar), completed the 3-minute Dialogue activity, then the same first-read error occurred. The 8081 server log at 10:11:50 shows `ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException` / `StaleObjectStateException` for `LearningPathPackage` id 569 in `InteractiveLearningPathServiceImpl.refreshInProgressPackage`: `current()` had loaded the package entity before acquiring its write lock, while another request finished the package. The package and activity were correctly saved; the retry returned 200. Backend now uses the existing `findByPathForUpdate` query to lock/load one consistent package snapshot and refreshes that instance. A focused test failed before the change; the complete `InteractiveLearningPathServiceTest` class passed 40/40. The 11-activity Selenium retest passed the exact Dialogue→roadmap transition; no new database-access error appeared after the app restarted with the fix.
6. **False full-path success in the Selenium runner — corrected:** the old loop tested `nextPendingItemUrl()` before its item cap. That method may click “Bắt đầu học” and navigate; on activity 11 the loop hit its cap *after* opening activity 12, so the final DOM check ran on a study page with no roadmap links and incorrectly passed. A read-only MySQL check of the retest path showed `ACTIVE`, 72 packages, 232 activities, only 3 packages completed, and package 4 in progress. The runner now checks its cap before any navigation and requires the server-owned summary status `COMPLETED` for the final assertion. The previous `BUILD SUCCESS` is valid only for the authenticated 11-activity prefix and race retest, **not** for whole-path completion.
7. **Completed-path navigation:** on a truly completed path, the quiz result now offers “Xem tổng kết lộ trình” instead of an active-only roadmap link (also handles finalization between API reads). The completed summary now offers “Chọn mục tiêu mới” rather than returning to an active-only path. Both changes have focused frontend regressions; the latter failed before the edit and passed after it. They have not yet had an actual completed-path browser UAT.

## Current measurements

- Frontend: `node --test src/test/frontend/*.test.cjs` — **325/325 passed**, zero skipped (latest run; earlier 322-test log predates the completed-path navigation additions).
- Backend focused: `InteractiveLearningPathServiceTest` **40/40 passed**, zero skipped, with the corrected Selenium source compiled.
- Backend full suite on this revision: **955 tests, 1 failure, 0 errors, 43 skipped** across 131 suites (Maven exit 1). The sole failure is `HandwritingCorpusAccuracyTest.recognitionOverTheWholeIndexIsFastEnoughForRealtime` in the separate Dictionary handwriting module: measured 111.64 ms above its test threshold. Isolated rerun after stopping the agent's 8081 app still failed at 100.19 ms. This is a repeatable gate failure, not merely a busy full-suite run; do not call the full backend gate green. No Dictionary code was changed in this task.
- Selenium login smoke after fix: **4/4 passed**, zero skipped.
- Page-object answer-helper tests: **3/3 passed**.
- Bounded journey on 8081: first six activities passed; overall `SmartTestToLearningPathE2ETest` failed its final full-path assertion because the deliberate six-item safety cap was reached. This is not a product failure and does not prove full-path completion.
- Second 8081 journey: 10 activities passed, Dialogue reached 188 server-measured seconds, bottom reached, and `COMPLETED` persisted. The following roadmap read failed from the captured race above. Log: `target/uat-server-8081.log`.
- Step logs and failure screenshots: `target/selenium-runs/` (each run has its own UTC timestamp and case directory).
- Initial failed journey: `2026-10-13T02-46-55.327441500Z-208ea83a-44b0-4fc4-a206-e11da6a8734a`.
- First completion and transient roadmap error on 8080: `2026-10-13T02-52-18.277574Z-dd81c6ca-f5ca-4fa2-8eb1-340185b0aed9`.
- Six-item bounded rerun on 8081: the most recent `SmartTestToLearningPathE2ETest` case under `target/selenium-runs/` at 10:02 local time.
- Eleven-item race retest on 8081: `target/selenium-runs/2026-10-13T03-15-54.098034900Z-fd223d85-350e-4a4b-949c-0942518e2c5e/`, 11 activity steps passed (including real 196-second Dialogue), browser closed cleanly. The runner's then-existing final assertion was false-positive as explained above.

Remaining acceptance: a genuine end-of-path run (or a suitably isolated deterministic full-completion fixture) must verify all 72 packages and final summary; Survey/Smart Test matrix, N3–N1 and BA/Travel/Daily paths, mobile checks, data/audio validity, AI functions and release/Jira gates remain separate evidence items. Do not label releases accepted from this bounded run.

The existing `http://localhost:8080/` browser tab was checked read-only earlier: its prior session had expired. The owner subsequently logged in again and explicitly asked testing to continue. The following live-account UAT was performed through the visible browser UI; no account credentials were read or changed.

## Live-account continuation — 13 October 2026

- Reopened the owner's existing `JLPT N5 to N4` path (N5→N4, 30 minutes/day, **131 lessons**). Before this continuation the path showed 0/131 overall, although the first vocabulary package's first section had already been completed. The path was not recreated or reset.
- Activity 231, Vocabulary section 2/2: verified the flashcard review counter at **14/14**. The user had already browsed all 14 cards; review opened with all 14 recorded.
- Submitted Micro Check 1/2: **20/20 (100%)**, 10/10 visible multiple-choice questions and 10/10 matching pairs. DOM evidence confirmed each selected choice and each matched row before submit. The result correctly offered the next check rather than marking the activity complete early.
- Submitted Micro Check 2/2: **8/8 (100%)**, 4/4 multiple-choice questions and 4/4 matching pairs. Result displayed “Đã đạt”, both test-attempt history tabs, per-question correct answer and learner choice, then the activity completion reward.
- Tested “Xem lại bài giảng” after both sections passed: it opened the correct read-only `mode=review&tab=content` view, showed “Chế độ xem lại”, “Phần 2 / 2”, and **14/14 đã xem**. No quiz result was mixed into the review lesson.
- Returned to the existing roadmap: server-rendered progress became **1/131 (1%)** and section 2/6 in chapter 1 became “Sẵn sàng”; completed section 1/6 listed both vocabulary sections as completed, with review, retake, and result links. Reward chip showed the expected +10 CP and one-day streak. No DB reset or direct API progress manipulation was used.
- Tested “Giải thích bằng AI” from the saved quiz history. It changed to a loading state and returned a contextual Vietnamese explanation with a Japanese example and Vietnamese translation in about 10 seconds. This is working for the selected answer. The baseline “Vì sao” line still repeats the answer text for these vocabulary items, so the non-AI explanation quality remains a content/UX defect.
- Confirmed the matching UI has 10 terms and 10 meanings (not 15), and after pairing all controls reported 10/10; the saved score was consistent with all 20 submitted responses.
- Opened the newly unlocked next Vocabulary activity (13 cards). Flipped the first card twice; it returned to the front and the viewed counter stayed at 1/13, as intended. Clicking “Bắt đầu kiểm tra” while 12 cards were unseen reached the quiz, but the browser automation accepted the native JavaScript confirmation automatically; this run cannot prove whether the owner’s “Hủy” choice keeps the learner in review. The quiz remained unanswered at 0/10 and 0/10 pairs. Navigated back to the roadmap without submitting it. The existing source contains the required `window.confirm`; verify OK/Hủy with an explicit dialog handler or manual UAT before changing code.

Scope limit: this authenticated run resumes an existing path midstream; it is not a fresh Survey/Smart Test matrix and does not prove all 131 lessons or other releases. The next browser step is the newly unlocked second section; broader path/release gates remain open.

## 2. Lỗi đã sửa

**Phần lớn là lỗi test harness; có 3 lỗi sản phẩm thật trong module interactive-learning (vocab/kanji) đã tìm và sửa:**

1. `N3FullJourneyE2ETest.workThroughPath`: sau khi hoàn thành package cuối, path tự chuyển COMPLETED và `/api/learning/v2/paths/current` **chủ động trả 404** (thiết kế đúng — path COMPLETED đọc qua `/paths/current/summary`). Bước `reload()` cuối của test dính 404 đó. Đã sửa: sau mỗi activity, test kiểm tra `isFullyCompleted()` qua summary endpoint rồi dừng, thay vì reload. Re-run: PASS sạch.
2. `DictionaryUiE2ETest` (sửa harness):
   - Fixture được chèn vào **đầu** trang thay vì cuối body — vì popup `position: fixed` mở ngay dưới vùng chọn; chèn cuối đẩy popup xuống mép viewport làm nút "Lưu từ" không bấm được.
   - **Collapse selection** trước khi bấm nút trong popup — vì selection lập trình còn sót lại khiến `pointerup` kích hoạt lại lookup và re-render popup, xoá mất xác nhận "Đã lưu" (người dùng thật bấm chuột sẽ tự clear selection).
   - **Mouse-drag offset** — `Actions.moveToElement` offset là **center-relative**; bản trước giả định top-left nên drag trượt dọc mép dưới chữ. Sửa `±(width/2)` (khép điểm `realMouseDragSelectionOnTextbookVocabulary`, mục 1.7).
3. **SẢN PHẨM — câu hỏi đảo chiều mơ hồ khi trùng nghĩa/cách đọc (vocab/kanji)**: `InteractiveVocabularyServiceImpl` và `InteractiveKanjiServiceImpl` sinh câu đảo chiều `MEANING_TO_WORD` / `READING_TO_WORD` (và kanji `READING_TO_KANJI`) ngay cả khi nghĩa/cách đọc đích **trùng với item khác trong batch** (vd. 夜中 / 真夜中 cùng "giữa đêm") → câu hỏi có 2 đáp án hợp lệ, learner không thể trả lời dứt khoát. Kèm harness `InteractiveActivityPage` đổi reverse-lookup trả **tập ứng viên** thay vì `findFirst` tuỳ tiện. Regression: `VocabularyQuestionGenerationTest`, `KanjiQuestionGenerationTest`, `InteractiveActivityPageTest` (10/10).
4. **Harness — stale-element khi lật flashcard**: flip re-render thay node `[data-card]` giữa lúc poll → `StaleElementReferenceException` làm N3 journey fail ở phase browse card. Sửa `wait = new WebDriverWait(...).ignoring(StaleElementReferenceException.class)` (field nâng lên `FluentWait<WebDriver>`).
5. **SẢN PHẨM — tương tác ghép cặp (Matching/nối từ) vocab + kanji** (`interactive-study.js`, `interactive-kanji-study.js`, `interactive-study.css`): hai cột giờ xáo trộn **deterministic theo attemptId** (mulberry32 + FNV-1a; reject hoán vị no-op), chọn/bỏ chọn/đổi/tháo cặp được từ **cả hai chiều** (word→meaning và meaning→word), một mục chỉ thuộc một cặp, phân biệt trạng thái đang chọn/đã ghép bằng màu + badge chữ cái, đáp án đúng không bao giờ xuống client (`correctOption`/`answerKey` vắng mặt), chấm theo stable `questionId`. Nút kiểm tra trên màn học giờ ghi rõ **"Bắt đầu/Tiếp tục kiểm tra — phần {n}/{tổng}"** khi quiz chia nhiều phần (server đã trả `currentBatch`/`batchCount` qua `/micro-check/state`). Regression frontend: `node --test src/test/frontend/*.test.cjs` **327/327 pass** (thêm test xáo trộn ổn định + tên phần).
6. **SẢN PHẨM — mở lại bài làm dở (reopen in-progress attempt)** (`LearningQuizSessionRepository`, `InteractiveStudyEngine.issueMicroCheck`): trước đây mỗi lần gọi `/micro-check` lại **tạo một session `ISSUED` mới**, nên learner rời giữa chừng rồi quay lại sẽ nhận đề mới (đổi thứ tự câu theo seed variation) thay vì đúng bài đang làm. Đã sửa: trước khi phát đề mới, engine tìm session `ISSUED` mới nhất của đúng (activity, quizType, batch, user) và trả lại **đúng `attemptId` + đúng thứ tự câu đã lưu** — không tạo mới, không tốn quota (quota vốn chỉ trừ lúc nộp). Thêm query `findFirstByActivityIdAndQuizTypeAndBatchIndexAndUserIdAndStatusOrderByIdDesc` + H2 regression `issuingAMicroCheckReopensAnInProgressAttemptInsteadOfCreatingANewSnapshot` (`InteractiveStudyEngineTest` **23/23 pass**).

# Data batch-fix map — runtime content-selection (Nhóm 5)

Re-checked against the **runtime** selector (not the content-admin columns). The earlier claim
"grammar N1–N3=0, only N4/N5" is **partly wrong**: at runtime-eligible scope grammar exists **only at N5**;
N4 is also 0. The metric that said "N4 present" counted a **DRAFT** N4 book. Runtime eligibility is decided by
`textbook.jlpt_level + textbook.status='PUBLISHED' + textbook.is_learning_path_source=1 + lesson.status='PUBLISHED'`
— never by a grammar-level tag (`grammar_point` has no level column).

## Diagnostic queries (re-run to confirm before any fix)

```sql
-- Grammar lessons per PUBLISHED textbook, split by the real eligibility gate.
SELECT t.id, t.title, t.jlpt_level, t.status, t.is_learning_path_source,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.skill='GRAMMAR' THEN l.id END) AS grammar_lessons,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_lessons
FROM textbook t
JOIN unit u        ON u.textbook_id = t.id
JOIN lesson l      ON l.unit_id = u.id
WHERE t.status = 'PUBLISHED'
GROUP BY t.id, t.title, t.jlpt_level, t.status, t.is_learning_path_source
ORDER BY t.jlpt_level, t.id;

-- Goal-specific path inputs (the real runtime axis, NOT lesson.situation_tag).
SELECT COUNT(*) AS learning_goal_rows FROM learning_goal;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS lesson_learning_scope_rows FROM lesson_learning_scope;

-- Mock exam bank (all DRAFT, but DRAFT is served by the practice surface — not the blocker there).
SELECT status, review_status, COUNT(*) FROM jlpt_exam GROUP BY status, review_status;
```

## Batch fixes — require OWNER content approval (NOT self-fixable)

These change which published books are eligible for the learning path. The books below are the legacy
"v8" owned books the seed docs mark as *"no longer selected for new paths … known source errors"*, so they
must be re-reviewed before any flip.

| Level | Fix | Candidate rows | SQL (run only AFTER owner re-review) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| N1 grammar | flip legacy book to lp-source | textbook id=16 `LP-OWNED-SHINKANZEN-MASTER-N1` (PUBLISHED, 12 grammar lessons, 97 gp) | `UPDATE textbook SET is_learning_path_source=1 WHERE id=16;` |
| N3 grammar | flip legacy book to lp-source | textbook id=14 `LP-OWNED-SPEED-N3` (PUBLISHED, 18 grammar, 179 gp) | `UPDATE textbook SET is_learning_path_source=1 WHERE id=14;` |
| N4 grammar | flip legacy book to lp-source | textbook id=13 `LP-OWNED-SPEED-N4` (PUBLISHED, 33 grammar, 71 gp) | `UPDATE textbook SET is_learning_path_source=1 WHERE id=13;` |
| N2 grammar | review then publish | textbook id=17 `LP-OWNED-NGU-PHAP-N2` (DRAFT, lp=1, 20 grammar lessons, 338 gp) | `UPDATE textbook SET status='PUBLISHED' WHERE id=17; UPDATE lesson l JOIN unit u ON l.unit_id=u.id SET l.status='PUBLISHED' WHERE u.textbook_id=17;` |

Alternative (preferred if the legacy books stay excluded): add **newly reviewed grammar lessons** into the
already-eligible lp-source books (id=21 N1, id=22 N3, id=19 N4 — currently vocabulary-only, 2–3 lessons each).

## Goal-specific path (BA / TRAVEL / DAILY_LIFE) — content rows do not exist yet

`learning_goal` = 0 rows and `lesson_learning_scope` = 0 rows, so **every** goal-specific path throws
`BLOCKED_CONTENT` at runtime (not just DAILY_LIFE). The prior report measured `lesson.situation_tag`
(BA=55, TRAVEL=10) but that column is only read by the content-admin dictionary screen, never by the selector.

Owner task (seed data, not a code change): create `learning_goal` rows
(`is_active=1`, `review_status='APPROVED'`, `goal_code IN ('JLPT','BA','TRAVEL','DAILY_LIFE')`) and matching
`lesson_learning_scope` rows (`goal_id`, `lesson_id`, `review_status='APPROVED'`, `scope_order`) for approved
PUBLISHED lessons.

## Mock test — one self-fixable item, but it is config, not data

- **Practice/exam surface** (`/api/jlpt/exams|practice/*`) already serves the 84 DRAFT exams
  (`status IN ('DRAFT','PUBLISHED')`), so DRAFT is **not** the blocker there; the gap is question-type taxonomy.
- **Learning-path "Mock Test" step** reads no bank at all — it is the
  `ConfiguredMockTestDestinationProvider` seam and returns `BLOCKED_INTEGRATION` until
  `learning.mock-test.destination-url` is set. Self-fixable only as a config key (points at a URL, adds no
  curriculum data):

```yaml
learning:
  mock-test:
    destination-url: "..."   # owner-provided URL
```

## Verdict

| Gap | Category | Owner or self? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| N1/N3/N4 grammar not runtime-eligible | has data, wrong ownership flag (legacy books) | **Owner** (re-review then flip / re-add lessons) |
| N2 grammar not published | has data, DRAFT only | **Owner** (review + publish) |
| BA/TRAVEL/DAILY_LIFE path blocked | no data (`learning_goal`/`lesson_learning_scope` empty) | **Owner** (seed content) |
| Path mock-test link | no config (`destination-url`) | Self (config, needs a URL) |

outputs/2026-10-14-jlpt-curriculum-sourc.text:
# JLPT N5–N3 task-owned source and live-path audit — 14/10/2026

This is a source-copy and read-only DB checkpoint, **not** publication or full-path UAT.
The local DB query is `outputs/2026-10-14-jlpt-curriculum-coverage.sql`; the Kanji
readiness query is `sql/audits/2026-10-12-smart-test-jlpt-readiness.sql`.

Owner direction received 14/10: DRAFT source content is acceptable for the
learning/demo path if the data is sufficient. This permits preparing task-owned
draft study content; it does not turn an incorrect or unmapped answer into a
valid scored question. Rows with structural answer holds remain excluded from
scoring until fixed and checked. Neither the runtime catalog nor the local web
DB has been changed by this checkpoint.

## Source copied without changing the digitization team’s files

| Slice | Exact task-owned copy | Current gate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sekai N5 | 25 lessons, 1,240 vocabulary occurrences, 132 grammar patterns | DRAFT copy; canonical N5 book is separately published in the current DB |
| Sekai N4 | 25 lessons, 1,258 vocabulary occurrences, 150 grammar patterns | DRAFT; verify every lesson’s audio/quiz/content mapping and approve IDs before publication |
| N4 Kanji | 184 unique source IDs in VNJPCLUB, with source lesson and URL | DRAFT source records; the scored Smart Test still has only 4 eligible distinct lexemes |
| N5–N3 Reading/Listening | 727 reading and 300 listening source passages with 5,277 linked question records | DRAFT crosswalk; answer/audio/content review and runtime mapping required |

The full source-copy artifact is
`data/learning-owned/learning-content.json` section `jlpt_sekai_n5_n4`. Every lesson has an
`LP-OWNED-SEKAI-*` ID, original path, source SHA-256 and all original teaching
sections. The Kanji artifact is
`data/learning-owned/learning-content.json` section `jlpt_n4_kanji`, with hashes for the
VNJPCLUB files, the 50 Sekai files, and the 13-question extraction.
Both builders passed their focused tests and `--check` reproducibility checks.
The separate comprehension builder produced
`data/learning-owned/learning-content.json` section `jlpt_comprehension_n5_n3`, keeping the original
passage, question, option, audio-link and source IDs under independent
`LP-OWNED-*` IDs. Its structural audit found N5: 176 reading/61 listening
passages, 707 linked questions, 27 answer-mapping holds; N4: 251/87,
1,681 questions, 34 holds; N3: 300/152, 2,889 questions, 146 holds.
There are also 49 N5, 74 N4 and 53 N3 passages with no linked question.
N4 has 2 and N3 has 4 audio links whose source `co_file` flag is false.
Crosswalking the source audio IDs against the owned-audio manifest resolved
1,164 N5–N3 links to explicit relative paths; all 1,164 files were present
under the supplied local audio tree on this machine. Six links remain
`WAITING_SOURCE` (N4 2, N3 4). File existence does not establish that the
clip speaks the matching question or that the browser can play it.
These counts do **not** mean the content is reviewed, scored or available in a path.

For a content-review queue, applying only structural gates (at least one
question, every marked answer matching its answer index, and a manifest-mapped
audio link for Listening) yields: N5 Reading 120/176 and Listening 43/61;
N4 Reading 187/251 and Listening 61/87; N3 Reading 206/300 and Listening
125/152. These are **review candidates**, not publishable scored items.
An exact-path file check found the 25 N5 and 25 N4 merged `chuan-nu`
audio files under the supplied audio root. Their source timing maps contain
3,079 N5 and 2,997 N4 clip references; every checked `ten`/`moc` array has
matching length and positive timing. This verifies file presence and timing
shape, **not** that each clip speaks the matching sentence or that all browser
audio playback works.

The 13 N4 seed-question crosswalk is especially important: `台所`, `野菜`,
`果物`, `牛乳`, `部屋`, `兄弟`, and `奥さん` have exact N5 source occurrences;
`建物`, `住所`, and `階段` have occurrences in both N5 and N4. Exact sources for
`主人`, `朝食`, and `夕食` were not found in these two source selections.
These observations prevent a bulk “all N4-tagged questions become JLPT N4”
update. Source occurrence alone does not settle JLPT difficulty.

An additional source-only check found **130/184** N4-book characters also appear
inside the 25 Sekai N5 vocabulary lessons; the other 54 merely lack an occurrence
in that selected N5 corpus. This overlap is not a JLPT-level judgment. Comparing
simple source readings with the repository's canonical Kanji reference after
NFKC/kana normalization found 124 matches, 55 compound readings needing manual
review, **2 conflicts**, and 3 missing readings. The conflicting source IDs are
`SHINKANZEN-N4-L168-KAN-003` (`道` as `ドア`) and
`SHINKANZEN-N4-L179-KAN-001` (`族` as `リョ`). They remain DRAFT and must be
corrected or held before quiz use.

The crosswalk also proposes **12 new, distinct N4 reading-question drafts**
(`LP-OWNED-JLPT-N4-KANJI-READ-001…012`) from exact N4 vocabulary source IDs.
Every proposed answer is the selected source word's reading, appears exactly
once among four options, and each distractor is another real N4 source word's
reading with its own source ID recorded. No selected word appears in the N5
Sekai or VNJPCLUB vocabulary selections. A read-only dictionary cross-check
found an exact expression/reading row tagged N4 and `PUBLISHED` for each of
the 12 selected words. That is supporting evidence for the reading and level,
not approval of these newly assembled questions. These are **not** scored questions:
distractor plausibility, alternative valid readings and JLPT level need a
content-owner decision per ID. The complete question/options/source mapping
is in `data/learning-owned/learning-content.json` section `jlpt_n4_kanji` under
`proposed_reading_drafts`.

The review-ready index `outputs/2026-10-14-jlpt-n5-n4-content-approval.md`
lists each of the 50 copied lessons, 13 existing N4 seed questions, and 12
proposed questions with IDs, source references, choices and current answer.
It is generated from the two DRAFT artifacts, not an approval record.

## Current local DB, read-only audit

Only `PUBLISHED` books with `is_learning_path_source=1` can feed a JLPT path.
The audit found **29 eligible N5 lessons, 3 N4 lessons, 3 N3 lessons**. Of these,
25 N5 lessons have grammar and dialogue; the three N4 and three N3 eligible
lessons have vocabulary but no grammar or dialogue rows. `content_item` rows
typed `READING` do exist, but the column alone is not evidence of a scored
Reading activity. No eligible N4/N3 lesson had a `LISTENING` content item.
In the copied Sekai JSON specifically, only 1/25 N5 lessons and 0/25 N4
lessons have `doc.hoi` reading questions; the separate VNJPCLUB passages are
therefore candidates for a complete Reading sequence, not a verified Sekai
lesson mapping.
The current `InteractivePackageComposerImpl.activitiesFor()` schedules only
Vocabulary, Kanji, Grammar and Dialogue in GOAL_LEARNING. Reading/Listening
are scheduled by `WarmUpBComposerImpl` from Smart Test evidence, not per
curriculum chapter. The user's requested Reading/Listening activities inside
every relevant roadmap chapter therefore require a separate runtime mapping
and composer change; simply importing passages would not make them appear.

The canonical Smart Test audit still reports N4 Kanji **4 selectable lexemes**
(first batch requires 5), N5 **6** (second same-level batch not proven) and
N3 **22** (both first and second same-level batches ready).

## Work needed before a complete user journey can be accepted

1. Review/approve source lesson IDs and semantic quality; verify script, audio,
   translations, choices and answer uniqueness. Preserve HOLD/DRAFT exclusions.
2. Build an idempotent task-owned SQL import with independent hierarchy and
   source mapping. Rehearse twice on scratch DB; check no shared source table,
   learner progress or existing path is changed. Publish only approved IDs.
3. For N4 Smart Test, approve enough **distinct** level-correct Kanji questions
   to satisfy adaptive batches; the 184 source characters are candidate source
   material, not 184 ready questions.
4. Run actual Selenium journeys for BELOW_N5→N5, N5→N5, N5→N4, N4→N4,
   N4→N3 and N3→N3, including every required skill, quiz/history/review,
   phase transition and server-owned `COMPLETED` summary. The latest N5→N4 run
   passed 101 activities but timed out at Dialogue activity 102.

## 2026-10-15 local N4 Learning-owned import (supersedes the DB snapshot above)

The owner approved using DRAFT textbook material as the main content of an
independent Learning copy. `sql/seeds/learning_owned_sekai_n4_core.sql` copied
source book 2 into task-owned book 4000002 (`LP-OWNED-SEKAI-N4-CORE`) without
editing the source book or its children. The owned copy is selectable by the
existing UI. It contains 25 lessons, 150 grammar points and 400 dialogue lines
with their source audio links. Source book 2 remains DRAFT.

The seed ran twice on a fresh scratch DB, then on a restored backup of the
local `jlas` DB. The restore matched a before/after learner-progress signature;
the owned copy was checked before applying it to local `jlas`. A full local
backup is `target/db-backups/jlas-before-owned-n4-1791997592.sql`, SHA-256
`762CC492D0B6C0360F0DE846C5A03AF088E0090C543CA70CCF1E2424E7327BE1`.
The signature remained unchanged after local apply. The restored audit DB is
`jlas_owned_n4_restore_1791997592`.

`LearningSourceReadinessAuditTest` against local MySQL passed 1/1 and reported
N4 **28 eligible lessons / 0 catalog gaps** (25 owned core + 3 earlier pilot).
This is catalog and DB evidence only. N4 Smart Test Kanji, chapter-level
Reading/Listening, and an entire Selenium path remain open gates; N3 core is
still DRAFT without verified item-level dialogue audio mapping.

## 4. Các quyết định cần owner — dưới dạng lựa chọn hoàn chỉnh

### 4.1 Timer / expired quiz (nhóm 4 + phần "mâu thuẫn" nhóm 6)

Hiện trạng: SmartTest/JLPT exam timer = **client-side only** (không server clock). Mâu thuẫn reviewer chỉ ra là có thật:
server **reject** bài quiz đã hết hạn → client **không thể** dùng chính endpoint bị reject đó để "auto-submit".

**Lựa chọn A — giữ client-clock + server chỉ chấp nhận submit trước deadline (khuyến nghị):**
- Server ghi `expiresAt` khi issue attempt; endpoint submit kiểm tra `now <= expiresAt` (nếu quá → `QUIZ_EXPIRED`).
- Client khi hết giờ chỉ hiển thị "Đã hết giờ" + nút "Nộp bài hiện có" gọi endpoint **grade với flag `expired=true`** riêng (không phải endpoint reject), server chấm những câu đã trả lời, không chấp nhận sửa.
- Ưu: không cần đồng hồ server chuẩn; nhược: người dùng chỉnh giờ máy gian lận.

**Lựa chọn B — server-clock authority:**
- Server trả `serverNow` + `deadline`; client đếm ngược từ `deadline - serverNow`, submit phải kèm `clientElapsed` để server so khớp.
- Ưu: chống gian lận; nhược: cần thêm endpoint server-time, phức tạp hơn.

**Lựa chọn C — không tính giờ (bỏ timer):** chỉ áp dụng nếu owner thấy timer không phải yêu cầu nghiệm thu.

### 4.2 Help-lock — ĐÃ TỰ IMPLEMENT (không cần quyết định lại)

Root scored check nhận `no-inline-dictionary` (block inline dict + "Lưu từ"), inline-dictionary.js `isEligibleNode()` chặn. Đã verify qua FE test 336/0/0 + grep jar. Không đụng micro-check learning (vẫn dùng inline dict lúc chấm).

### 4.3 Reward 5 CP — ĐÃ SỬA + TEST (không cần quyết định lại)

5 CP **mỗi chương** (`SOURCE_LESSON` = lesson nguồn, ổn định qua replan), de-dupe idempotent. Test khẳng định đúng 5 + tổng chương + không trùng + không PACKAGE. Nếu owner vẫn muốn "mỗi package" thì đây là điểm duy nhất cần lật lại.

### 4.4 DeepSeek — ĐÃ CHẠY LỜI GỌI THẬT (14/10)

- **(a) Đã đạt:** key hiện có trong `application-local.yaml` (không in) → `POST /chat/completions` trả `200` trong 301ms, `response_format=json_object` parse `ok=true`. Fallback khi provider lỗi là best-effort `null` (code-reviewed) — advisory-only giữ nguyên.
- (b) không còn áp dụng.

### 4.5 Content gap (nhóm 9 — cần content-owner, không phải code)

| Gap | Phân loại (đã verify runtime) | SQL batch-fix chờ duyệt |
| --- | --- | --- |

| Grammar N2 không publish | có data, DRAFT (id 17, lp=1) | `UPDATE textbook SET status='PUBLISHED' WHERE id=17;` + publish lesson |
| BA/TRAVEL/DAILY_LIFE path bị chặn | **không có data** (`learning_goal`=0, `lesson_learning_scope`=0) | seed `learning_goal` + `lesson_learning_scope` (việc seed, không phải code) |
| Path Mock Test link | config thiếu `learning.mock-test.destination-url` | tự sửa được (config, cần URL owner) |

Chi tiết + câu SQL đầy đủ: `outputs/2026-10-14-data-batch-fix.md`.

### 4.6 Mock Test thật (nhóm 10 / luồng 17)

Cần provider thật (branch/commit/PR implementation có API/port hợp đồng + kết quả attempt). Tới khi có, luồng 17 ghi `BLOCKED_INTEGRATION`.

## 5. Bàn giao cho reviewer chạy độc lập

1. **Build + run:** `./mvnw clean package -DskipTests` → `java -jar target/jlas-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar` (cần `application-local.yaml` datasource; `ddl-auto=validate`).
2. **Provision learner:** chạy `CreateE2ETestUserTool` với env §0 (không cần credential; mật khẩu ngẫu nhiên).
3. **Selenium:** `outputs/reviewer-selenium-run.ps1` (N3 journey) + `scripts/selenium/run-acceptance-remaining.ps1` (full-journey N5 + isolation + dictionary).
4. **Log/screenshot:** mỗi test ghi `target/*.log` + SeleniumStepLog từng bước (PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED, không log password/token/cookie).
5. **Không làm:** commit/push/merge, áp DB chia sẻ, DROP DB, reset tiến độ owner, chạy seed huỷ diệt trên DB có dữ liệu.

# Proposal — server-clock timer + scored-quiz help lock (Nhóm 4)

Status: help-lock is **required and being implemented** (independent of the timer ruling). The timer's
**duration, unit and expiry handling** are the parts that still need an owner ruling; this proposal pins
those down to concrete per-type options so the owner only picks, not re-investigates.

## Verified current state

| Concern | Where | Reality |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Smart Test timer | `templates/smart-test.html` `#questionTimer` (+ smart-test JS) | **client-side only**; `smart_test_session` has **no deadline/expiry column**; a learner can pause/inspect the clock. |
| JLPT exam timer | `templates/jlpt-exam.html` `#jlptTimer` | **client-side only**, same exposure. |
| Help lock (scored quizzes) | micro-check / jlpt-exam / lesson-quiz pages | answer-revealing affordances (inline dictionary, "Lưu từ", hint) are gated in JS only; the server never re-asserts a "no-help during scoring" rule. |
| Learning micro-check | `interactive-study.js` inline dictionary + "Lưu từ" | still usable while a scored micro-check is on screen — **to be locked** (required, not optional). |

## One consistent end/grade mechanism (resolves the prior contradiction)

The prior draft said the client should "auto-submit" through the same endpoint the server rejects on
expiry — that is self-contradictory. The consistent mechanism is:

- **The server owns the deadline.** When an attempt is issued it persists `expires_at`; the client only
  renders a drift-corrected countdown from `{ serverNow, expiresAt }` and never owns the deadline.
- **Writes stop at the deadline, reads finalise.** The answer/submit endpoint rejects with
  `ErrorCode.QUIZ_EXPIRED` once `serverNow > expiresAt`. There is **no** client "auto-submit" through that
  endpoint. Instead the client, on expiry, calls a single **`finalize`** path (or simply reloads), and the
  server grades the answers that were persisted **before** the deadline — unanswered questions are scored
  incorrect. Finalisation is **idempotent and server-owned**: a repeated `finalize`/read returns the same
  result and never accepts a late answer.
- **One grading function, two entries.** Normal submit (before deadline) and `finalize` (at/after deadline)
  both funnel into the same scoring function; the only difference is the deadline check. This mirrors the
  existing "server — not client — decides state" rule already in the codebase (e.g. `InteractiveStudyEngine`
  flips `STUDYING -> CHECK_READY` on load).

So the rule is: **late writes are refused; late reads grade what was saved in time.** No client can keep
answering past the deadline, and no client is asked to submit through a refused endpoint.

## Timer — per-type options (owner decides duration/unit/expiry only)

| Type | Current visible timer | Proposed unit | Expiry handling (already fixed above) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Smart Test (adaptive) | per-question countdown | per-question seconds (existing config) | finalise-on-expiry, grade saved answers |
| JLPT Mock exam | per-part countdown | per-part minutes | finalise-on-expiry, grade saved answers |
| Scored micro-check | none today | whole-session minutes (owner picks default) | finalise-on-expiry, grade saved answers |
| Lesson/gate quiz | none today | whole-session minutes (owner picks default) | finalise-on-expiry, grade saved answers |

**Open questions (owner only, each already narrowed to a concrete choice):**

1. Scored micro-check & gate quiz default duration (e.g. 10 min? 15 min?) and unit (minutes per whole quiz,
   not per question).
2. Whether the Smart Test per-question countdown also gets a hard whole-session cap (recommend: yes, derived
   from `per-question × questions-per-batch` to avoid a second source of truth).
3. Where `expires_at` lives: add a column to the existing attempt/session row (Smart Test `smart_test_session`,
   JLPT attempt, `learning_quiz_session` for micro-check) — recommend reusing existing rows, not new tables.

## Help lock — required, being implemented now (not waiting on timer)

Lock answer-revealing affordances **while a scored quiz is active** (micro-check `CHECK_READY`/scored mode,
JLPT exam part, lesson quiz). Scope: disable the inline dictionary, "Lưu từ", and hint buttons in scored
mode; keep them in learn/study mode. Server-side the lock is advisory (a flag on the issue response the FE
honours) — consistent with the current client-gating posture, and no policy decision blocks it.

No timer code is written until the duration/unit ruling lands; the help-lock is implemented in parallel.
